claims.text: Role in pinworm: tx only symptomatic infections (seldom harmful, reinfestation common);
claims.quote: Because pinworm infestation is seldom harmful, prevalence is high, and reinfestation is common, treatment is indicated only for symptomatic infections.

claims.text: a single dose of mebendazole, pyrantel pamoate or albendazole, repeated in 2 wks, eradicates pinworms (⍉ ova) in > 90%;
claims.quote: A single dose of mebendazole, pyrantel pamoate, or albendazole, repeated in 2 weeks, is effective in eradicating pinworms (but not ova) in > 90% of cases.

claims.text: treating the whole family may be needed.
claims.quote: Multiple infestations within the household are common, and treatment of the entire family may be necessary.

claims.text: Mebendazole (Emverm) label: pinworm dose: 1 tablet once.
claims.quote: Pinworm (enterobiasis) Whipworm (trichuriasis) Roundworm (ascariasis) Hookworm Dose 1 tablet once 1 tablet morning and evening for 3 consecutive days 1 tablet morning and evening for 3 consecutive days

claims.text: Same schedule for adults and children two years and older; the tablet may be chewed, swallowed or crushed and mixed w food.
claims.quote: The same dosage schedule applies to adults and pediatric patients two years of age and older. The tablet may be chewed, swallowed, or crushed and mixed with food.

claims.text: Not cured three wks after tx: a second course is advised.
claims.quote: If the patient is not cured three weeks after treatment, a second course of treatment is advised.

claims.text: CI: known hypersensitivity to the drug or its excipients.
claims.quote: EMVERM® is contraindicated in persons with a known hypersensitivity to the drug or its excipients.
convulsions have been reported in infants below the age of 1 year during post-marketing experience with mebendazole

claims.text: Agranulocytosis and neutropenia at higher doses or longer durations than recommended: monitor blood counts then.
claims.quote: Agranulocytosis and neutropenia have been reported with mebendazole use at higher doses and for more prolonged durations than is recommended for the treatment of soil-transmitted helminth infections. Monitor blood counts if EMVERM® is used at higher doses or for prolonged duration.

claims.text: SJS/TEN reported w mebendazole + metronidazole: ⍉ the combo.
claims.quote: Stevens-Johnson syndrome/toxic epidermal necrolysis (SJS/TEN) have been reported with the concomitant use of mebendazole and metronidazole. Avoid concomitant use of mebendazole and metronidazole
